# Record the bounded frontend technical contract and remaining decision gates



## Task kind

Investigation

## Workflow status

## Requirement and specification

Produce one source-linked decision/contract register that lets each frontend task identify its executable core and exact blocked slice. Limit technical freeze work to runtime/tooling, routes, service identity/revision/operation conventions and mock persistence/scenario conventions. Inventory remaining source OPEN items and assign their ownership; this task does not resolve every flow question or create a new product-design phase. Routine compatible engineering choices require rationale and shared-contract consistency, not ceremonial owner approval; unresolved user-visible alternatives remain owner decisions.

## Scope

- Inventory the unapproved scaffold and propose the smallest coherent runtime/test arrangement for React, Zustand and shadcn controls; record rationale, compatibility evidence and approval state without installing packages.
- Specify route/return-intent allowlisting and common account/project/preparation/operation/generation/revision identifiers, errors, idempotency and reconciliation responsibilities for the facade and mock producers.
- Record named unresolved product/policy/evidence items once, with source, affected task/AC, decision owner, proposed next proof/question and resume condition. Freeze resolved technical slices independently; unsettled product behavior stays blocked.

Ask whether Account has a separate allowed return intent; do not choose a route or rewrite either spec. Only that non-project return slice is blocked; settled same-project return and ordinary New dub remain unchanged.

- Inventory the cataloged Clean/Light source/PNG and Mabry availability, the accepted source-to-shadcn mapping/derivative ownership in shell #78 and screen consumers, and any remaining source/contrast/rendered-evidence gaps. Record confirmed adoption without drawing a new style or reopening the owner's retained Mabry decision.

## Out of scope

Product code, dependency installation, backend/API implementation, prices, new abuse/retention/retry policies, resolving every flow OPEN item, GitHub mutations and reopening settled behavior. A report may conclude that a required slice remains blocked.

## Implementation anchors and invariants

Actual inspected anchors: `frontend/package.json` has dev/build/lint/preview scripts and packages from an interrupted scaffold; `frontend/src/` contains App/main/style files. Neither package presence nor old evidence approves versions or proves commands work. HANDOFF (local reviewed source: `_docs/HANDOFF.md#current-owner-steering-2026-10-22-asiaqyzylorda`) preserves the stop instruction. SPEC-001 frontend boundary (local reviewed source: `_docs/specifications/SPEC-001_dubbed_mvp.md`) retains centralized services and a backend-free mock. No production API or existing approved services implementation is assumed. This task creates the register document, not a second specification or issue queue.

- Blocks: runtime ([#67](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/67)), facade ([#68](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/68)), shell ([#78](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/78)), accounting ([#70](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/70)), and affected decision slices in the mock/browser gate ([#63](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/63)). Inventory completeness does not require resolving those gates or silently changing source specifications.
- [ ] AC-02: Every selected technical slice has evidence/rationale, input/output contract, writer/consumer ownership and approval state; unresolved user-visible questions remain blocked with a concrete resume condition.
- [ ] AC-03: The register preserves 0.001-second source selection, no manual dialogue Stop, zero-turn prior-preparation preservation, explicit-exit navigation priority and separate authorized/displayed result identity.
- [ ] AC-04: Runtime reuse is a reviewed proposal, not automatic approval of the scaffold; all downstream prerequisites can distinguish required technical freeze from unrelated production-policy gaps.

## Verification plan

Static read of all twelve active decision registers and latest batch; trace each entry to the exact clause and consumer draft, inspect reciprocal dependencies and report omissions/conflicts. Record document hashes, date, environment, dirty-worktree boundary and report path. No product/runtime/provider checks are claimed. Use Context7 only when investigating actual tool/library compatibility, under repository instructions; no installs or production experiments are authorized by this task.

Deliver the reviewed bounded register and unresolved-question/evidence handoff locally. Accepting the report accepts its completeness and honesty, not unresolved policy or dependent implementation. Publication, implementation and external effects remain separately authorized.

## Increment and context

An authenticated owner can inspect/control supported access settings and leave safely through current-session sign-out or confirmed all-session account deletion. Recording exit, purchased-credit disclosure, unknown outcomes and late callbacks cannot be hidden behind a successful-looking navigation.

## Scope

- Account screen: locale saving, authoritative Google/email-password method rows and owning-flow handoffs, Current password/New password change, Sign out and final destructive account-deletion section.
- Account/password-change/current-session-end/deletion/status domain mock handlers and coordinator, consuming recording-owned exit/lease APIs, shared persistence/revision/session services and authoritative accounting facts.
- Localized confirmation, account deletion propagation/late-event denial fixtures, private-cache clearing, signed-out landing confirmation and later re-registration integration checks.
- Focused component, domain-contract and browser checks. The Account task owns sign-out coordination used from the common menu as well as Account; shell supplies the entry, recording owns guard/lease internals.

- Visual composition: Compose preserved Account sections with cataloged BTN buttons and PRO menu/quiet-row anatomy plus explicitly derived status treatments; use named input/password, locale-selector and dialog/phone-sheet derivatives. Preserve section order, exact localized deletion token and guarded sign-out; source filter behavior adds no Account feature.

## Out of scope

- Profile/avatar/display-name edits, notifications/appearance settings, unlink/disconnect, new contact-email semantics, sharing controls/public links/viewers.
- Backend deletion, production session/worker/download revocation, physical cache/backup/CDN cleanup or a retention/financial policy chosen by the frontend.
- Automatic refund, refund-first/spend-first deletion gate, refund guarantee/waiver, restoration of deleted state, automatic recreation or reauthentication added to deletion.

## Implementation anchors and invariants

No approved Account implementation anchor is established; inspect actual checkout and accepted prerequisites before locating code. The interrupted scaffold and deleted SPEC-002 are not adopted. Flow 15 section 12 supplies logical service responsibilities, not concrete endpoint/file names.

Account facts and navigation use one authorized account/revision. Display exactly Google and email/password families with service association state. Direct change has only Current password/New password, settled minimum 8 and no required classes; reset stays separate. Password change/reset keep current device signed in and end all other sessions. Ordinary sign-out ends only the current session after candidate resolution and lease release. Deletion ends every account session and logically removes account projects/takes/recordings/results/download access, with no physical-erasure or external-MP4-retraction promise. Service-authoritative remaining purchased credits are distinct from available/trial/reserved credits; a positive amount warns but never blocks deletion for spending/refund contact.

## Dependencies and ownership

- Depends on: sign-in/session entry ([#80](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/80)), reset ([#71](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/71)), manual linking ([#66](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/66)), recording/draft/acceptance ([#77](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/77)).
- Blocks: browser integration gate ([#63](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/63)).
- Owner: unassigned human/executor. Responsibility: Account UI and account/password/session-exit/deletion domain handlers and coordinator. Recording owns save/discard/stay/lease state; registration owns new-account/no-repeat-grant behavior; accounting owns purchased-credit facts; project/result owners own their domain read/fence consumers. Integrate their contracts without duplicating handlers; serialize shared composition changes.
- Priority: unset.
- Blocking decisions: Flow 15 section 17 remaining password/counting/abuse policy; truthful financial/security/backup/cache/CDN/provider retention disclosure; minimum returning-identity eligibility/privacy/retention mechanics; real refund/reversal/financial-record policy and support address before live release; font/assets/final copy and actual service evidence. Clarify the non-project Account-after-expiry destination conflict recorded in sign-in ([#80](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/80)) and contract decisions ([#61](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/61)) before claiming that return. Settled localized token, no reauth, nonblocking purchased balance and session effects are not open. Synthetic fixtures may prove their UI without inventing operational policy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-01: Only the current authenticated owner sees Account facts; loading/partial/stale/account-switch/expiry states expose no guessed or prior-account facts. Section order is Language, methods, Sign out, destructive deletion last. Locale saving applies all visible states together and failure retains/restores authoritative preference with Retry. (F15-AC01/02.)
- [ ] AC-02: Rows show only authoritative method-specific facts and supported verification/reset/link continuations. No inference from equal email strings, no unlink/remove/disconnect or invented primary email exists. Direct change has only Current/New password; field/service errors and active-value preservation follow the shared contract; successful authoritative change keeps current device signed in and ends every other session. Remaining password policy stays blocked. (F15-AC03/04.)
- [ ] AC-03: Common-menu and Account Sign out use the same coordinator. An unaccepted candidate first offers Save and leave / Leave without saving / Stay. Save failure or Stay sends no logout; discard preserves a prior accepted take. Completed exit releases/reconciles owned recording access before ending only the current session. Unknown release/end results reconcile; only authoritative success/already-ended clears private state and opens signed-out landing, retaining other-device sessions. (F15-AC05; F02-AC18.)
- [ ] AC-04: Delete account shows authorized account and complete known irreversible logical consequences, including authoritative remaining purchased credits. Accessible desktop dialog/phone sheet requires DELETE in EN or УДАЛИТЬ in RU, case-insensitive after trimming edge whitespace only; wrong locale/extra/internal characters fail. No password/provider reproof is added. Cancel/Escape/close before submission sends no deletion and returns focus. A positive purchased remainder does not disable deletion or require spending/refund first, and deletion emits no refund request/waiver/guarantee. (F15-AC06.)
- [ ] AC-05: One account/revision-bound idempotent deletion operation is reconciled after duplicate click, timeout, reload, stale state or already-deleted result. Unknown/failure never shows Account deleted or success navigation. Authoritative logical disablement ends all sessions, hides all private product data, denies new owner media/result authorization and fences delayed job/upload/download responses. The ordinary signed-out landing shows localized Account deleted, with no standalone page, auto-sign-in or recreation. (F15-AC07/08.)
- [ ] AC-06: Later explicit same-email/Google registration can create a new canonical account with no deleted projects/balance/state and no repeat welcome grant. Mocks integrate registration-owned eligibility results without a client-readable deleted-identity marker. Already downloaded/distributed files are explicitly outside the erasure claim. (F15-AC07.)
- [ ] AC-07: EN/RU, manual/browser/account locale precedence, current Clean/Light tokens, preserved Account section hierarchy, breakpoint/gutters/controls, keyboard/dialog focus/status/zoom/reduced motion and error placement meet the shared contract. Secrets/private identifiers/tokens/deletion internals remain out of public state, durable form state, logs, URLs and analytics. (F15-AC02/09/10/12.)
- [ ] AC-08: Domain mock checks label password mutation, revocation, deletion, lease/cross-device durability and retention effects as simulations. No no-sharing boundary is violated; production deletion/retention/refund/worker/access evidence remains blocked/unverified until real adapters and approved policy exist. (F15-AC11; F15-AC06/07 live gates.)

- [ ] AC-VIS-01: Applicable Clean/Light component appearance and states follow the current adoption/token contract with Mabry Pro and shadcn semantics. Cover locale-save pending/failure, method facts, invalid password, deletion cancel/error/unknown and soft-red destructive confirmation. Record the exact reference pair/state/value map and explicit derivative/contrast corrections; preserve every functional AC above. Missing required font/source/browser evidence blocks the affected visual claim.

## Verification plan

Not run. After implementation authorization, use isolated synthetic accounts with two or more mock sessions, controlled revisions and delayed events; never delete a real account or call real identity/payment/media services. Use commands discovered by the accepted runtime, recording them exactly in evidence.

1. AC-01/02: contract/component matrix for authorized/foreign/expired/unavailable/partial snapshots, method association states, locale save failure, direct-password wrong-current/too-short/stale/timeout/success and zero method-removal commands. Compare session fixtures to prove change revokes others while retaining current.
2. AC-03: browser sign-out from both entries with no candidate, each candidate branch, failed save, completed last-gap save, lease already released, failed/unknown release and unknown session end/reload. Inspect ordered calls: guard, release, end-current; zero logout on Stay/save failure and no success before authoritative end. Explicit sign-out navigation wins over background initial assembly; recording owns that authorization behavior.
3. AC-04: EN/RU tokens, mixed/lower case, edge whitespace, wrong-locale token, internal/extra characters, Cancel/Escape/focus return, zero/positive purchased remainder distinct from trial/reservations; require no refund request or spend/refund gate. Record policy disclosure blocks separately.
4. AC-05/06: lost response before/after disablement, duplicate clicks, reload, stale account switch, already-deleted state and delayed worker/upload/result/download callbacks. Require one operation, no premature success, no accessible deleted content or late resurrection. Integrate later explicit re-registration and assert new account ID, zero restored data and no repeat grant. Real signed URL/worker/device invalidation remains unproved by simulation.
5. AC-07/08: EN/RU keyboard/screen-reader/dialog lifecycle, secret/public-cache inspection and screenshots at 390/767/768/desktop, 200% zoom/short viewport/reduced motion; measure tokens/focus/control geometry and actual font loading. Verify no sharing route/token/viewer or physical-erasure/external-file retraction promise.

Evidence records command/procedure, expected/observed result, environment, date, revision/dirty boundary, scenario and artifact location. Final gate integrates Account with recording/projects/results/registration; real-adapter follow-up owns real session/worker/media/privacy evidence. A mock PASS is not live deletion or product acceptance.

Visual checks for AC-VIS-01: follow `_docs/frontend-flows/affect-ui-workflow.md`; inspect final actual-browser screenshots against the cataloged Light PNGs and Clean values at desktop, 767/768px and 390px in EN/RU, plus applicable zoom/short-viewport states. ## Increment and context

A person can request recovery through a neutral interface, supply the correct purpose-bound proof, set a new password and represent the authoritative current-device sign-in/other-session termination result. Reset cannot finish registration or silently resume linking.

## Scope

- Request, neutral response/code entry, resend/replacement, New password/Repeat new password and reconciliation/success states in EN/RU.
- Recovery domain mock handlers, purpose/identity/request binding, pending restoration and password/session outcome fixtures through the centralized facade.
- Reuse the registration-owned accessible six-cell interaction with separate reset purpose/context; consume session/destination primitives and focused contract/component/browser tests.

- Visual composition: Reuse cataloged button and otp-input presentation with explicit input/password derivatives in the existing reset hierarchy; preserve two new-password fields, six logical code cells, neutral response and product code/resend policy.

## Out of scope

- Actual email delivery, production code generation/verification/security, password storage, session infrastructure or backend implementation.
- Account creation, pending-registration completion, automatic/manual linking, Account direct password change and My projects as reset default.
- Selecting remaining password, abuse/attempt, code consumption or pending retention policy.

## Implementation anchors and invariants

No approved reset code anchor exists. Inspect the accepted runtime/facade and actual checkout; the interrupted scaffold and deleted SPEC-002 are not adopted. Flow 04 section 8 gives logical responsibilities, not endpoints/source paths.

Every syntactically valid identity class receives exactly the same neutral response and code-entry interface: If an account with this email exists, we sent a code. This is not delivery, existence or reset-eligibility proof. Syntax and actionable transport failures remain distinct and existence-neutral. Only authoritative valid reset-purpose proof permits password submission. Codes follow the approved six-decimal-digit/10-minute/60-second/five-per-hour/new-code-replaces-old rules. Timers cannot extend validity. Both new-password fields are required, must match and use the settled minimum 8/no character-class requirement. Successful durable reset establishes the current-device fixed 30-day session and terminates every other session; incomplete/unknown revocation is not completed success.

## Dependencies and ownership

- Depends on: sign-in/session recovery ([#80](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/80)), verified registration/code interaction ([#82](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/82)).
- Blocks: Account ([#62](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/62)), browser integration gate ([#63](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/63)).
- Owner: unassigned human/executor. Responsibility: reset-domain handlers/UI/tests and reset binding of the shared code interaction. Reuse session infrastructure and avoid duplicating registration or linking logic. Shared facade/composition edits are coordinated sequentially.
- Priority: unset.
- Blocking decisions: Flow 04 `OPEN-03` remaining password policy/counting; `OPEN-06` invalid-attempt/lockout, precise hourly-window accounting, post-success consumption/replay and abuse mechanics; narrowed `OPEN-08` cleared-data/longer-retention behavior. Contract decisions ([#61](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/61)) records required slices; use explicitly synthetic mock outcomes without adopting production constants. Real mail/identity/session services and evidence are external prerequisites. Settled neutral response, code timing, same-browser recovery and New dub/project destination do not remain open.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-01: Request UI provides identical neutral response/code entry for existing password, Google-only, unverified, disabled, deleted and nonexistent synthetic identities. Invalid syntax and existence-neutral transport failures retain safe correction; cancellation mutates no account. No Account not found branch or delivery/existence claim is produced. (AC-04-01/02/07.)
- [ ] AC-02: One logical code appears in six accessible cells, supports whole-code paste/autofill and auto-verifies changed complete values once. Duplicate/in-flight/unchanged rerenders are suppressed; authoritatively incorrect digits remain visible and selected with an error underneath. Timeout is unknown and reconciles before retry. (AC-04-03.)
- [ ] AC-03: Service send/expiry/resend/cap facts drive display; a new code replaces the old. Same-browser reload restores selected email/code-entry from an opaque reference without auto-resend, passwords or success inference. Another device starts a fresh purpose-bound request under unchanged limits, without context transfer. Open longer-retention/hour/attempt mechanics stay explicit. (AC-04-03/06.)
- [ ] AC-04: Only valid matching reset proof enables New password/Repeat new password. Presence, settled minimum 8 and equality are enforced without character-class additions. Mismatch is beneath Repeat; other field errors beneath fields and service errors above Set new password. Active values survive service failure and clear at exit/success without durable persistence. (AC-04-04.)
- [ ] AC-05: Only authoritative durable password/session/revocation completion produces success: current device has its new 30-day session and every other session ends. Partial/failure/unknown outcomes reconcile without premature success navigation. Valid persisted project return rebuilds that screen without command replay; otherwise New dub opens, never My projects by default. (AC-04-05.)
- [ ] AC-06: Registration/link-candidate codes cannot reset passwords; reset proof cannot complete registration, add/link a method, apply to another request/identity or silently satisfy manual link proof. Recovery initiated from linking follows its own project/New dub destination; later manual linking begins explicitly with fresh dual proof. (AC-04-05/07; F05-AC09.)
- [ ] AC-07: EN/RU, locale precedence, keyboard/focus/status, accessible visibility/autofill/paste and shared token/responsive/motion values match the contract. Passwords/codes do not enter URLs, durable Zustand/browser state, logs, analytics or public errors. (AC-04-08/10.)
- [ ] AC-08: Mocks cover meaningful failures, used/replaced/revoked/expired/attempt-limited proof, expiry between check/submit, duplicate mutation and uncertain session effects. Reports identify simulations and open policy, and claim no real deliverability, ownership, security, cross-device revocation or provider evidence. (AC-04-06/09.)

- [ ] AC-VIS-01: Applicable Clean/Light component appearance and states follow the current adoption/token contract with Mabry Pro and shadcn semantics. Cover request/code pending, known invalid code retained/selected, unknown verification, resend unavailable, field/service error and password submit loading. Record the exact reference pair/state/value map and explicit derivative/contrast corrections; preserve every functional AC above. Missing required font/source/browser evidence blocks the affected visual claim.

## Verification plan

Not run. After execution authorization, use the actual runtime test commands against an isolated mock workspace and controllable service clock; no real recovery email/account mutation. Record synthetic policy assumptions explicitly.

1. AC-01: compare visible/accessible response and available actions across all six identity classes, with identical neutral strings and no private existence branch. Separately exercise syntax/service failures and cancellation with zero mutation calls.
2. AC-02/03: type 5 then 6 digits, paste/autofill once, edit a completed value, rerender, double activate and lose a verification response. Inspect call counts, preserved/selected invalid code, 10-minute expiry, 59/60-second resend, fifth/sixth sends and previous-code replacement. Hour boundary/attempt-consumption expectations remain blocked until defined.
3. AC-03/06: reload pending/expired/success, Back/Forward and new-device request; require no auto-email, password restoration, context transfer, limit bypass or cross-purpose/identity proof use.
4. AC-04/05: required/equality/7/8-character cases; policy reject, stale conflict, failure and response loss. Verify exactly one represented mutation, current-session anchor, all-other-session invalidation fixture and no success on partial/unknown. Test valid/invalid/deleted/foreign/stale project return and zero processing/capture/billing/assembly replay.
5. AC-06: enter reset from manual linking, finish to approved reset destination, then start linking explicitly; both fresh proofs remain required. Reset never creates a candidate method/account/grant.
6. AC-07/08: EN/RU and saved/manual/browser locale permutations; keyboard/screen-reader, storage/privacy inspection and screenshots at 390/767/768/desktop, zoom/reduced motion. Measure approved tokens/focus/form bounds and record font/fallback evidence separately.

Evidence records command/procedure, expected/observed result, environment, date, revision/dirty boundary, scenario and artifact location. Real email delivery, binding/consumption/replay protection and device revocation checks remain in the real-adapter follow-up. A neutral UI response or mock PASS proves none of them.

Visual checks for AC-VIS-01: follow `_docs/frontend-flows/affect-ui-workflow.md`; inspect final actual-browser screenshots against the cataloged Light PNGs and Clean values at desktop, 767/768px and 390px in EN/RU, plus applicable zoom/short-viewport states. Verify loaded Mabry weights/metrics and computed component/native/real-input fonts, including removal of source Inter declarations that would override a global Mabry family; inspect source-mapped geometry, keyboard focus, disabled/loading/error/selected states, dialog behavior where applicable, bounded functional motion and immediate reduced-motion equivalents. Record environment/date/revision or dirty boundary, exact reference paths, expected/actual, screenshots and timing/interaction evidence. No build, token arithmetic, mock state or screenshot capture without inspection substitutes for visual proof.

## Increment and context

An owner can rehearse/capture a fixed automatically supplied turn, review its sole unaccepted candidate, recover it only when durably account-associated, and explicitly accept it safely. The same increment owns the all-turn acceptance trigger and candidate/navigation guards because splitting them would leave acceptance, assembly authorization and explicit exits inconsistent.

## Scope

- Load current project/processing/turn/timing revisions, fixed window including margins, authoritative turn order, accepted eligibility, recoverable draft and exclusive recording grant. Continue unfinished work at first missing accepted take; Return from Result at first established turn. No list/picker/last-viewed navigation.
- Largest moving video, smaller readable target below, then one playable waveform, one transport and Original/My recording toggle, independent reference volume, Back/Next and separate position/accepted-progress counters. My recording stays visible disabled with a record-first explanation until usable candidate/compatible accepted audio exists; candidate audition takes priority over protected accepted media.
- Listen uses the identical full fixed window. My recording plays once and stops without loop/acceptance/advance. Source switches restart at window beginning, continuing only if already playing; paused/inactive stays paused. New turn and finalized capture wait for explicit action.
- Explicit Record supersedes either audition and starts from fixed-window beginning immediately after actual microphone/reference readiness, without countdown. Moving video plus full original audio continues during microphone capture. No manual dialogue Stop; capture auto-stops at window end even if speech ends earlier. Only local reference volume stays adjustable; transport/scrub/source/turn/workspace/all other actions are disabled during active capture. In-app leave cannot become an early-stop shortcut; browser/OS interruption remains possible.
- Device/reference-clock loss and phone background/screen lock stop active capture and synchronized reference. Return never auto-resumes. Finalization returns actually usable compatible full/partial media as unaccepted candidate; zero-data yields error/Retry recording; silence/quiet captured media is not zero-data. No arbitrary minimum duration/quality gate is introduced.
- Preserve accepted media until compatible accepted association commits. During rerecord, preserve earlier candidate until valid usable replacement finalizes atomically, including usable interrupted partial. Failed/unusable/zero-data/incompatible recapture preserves it. Exactly one current candidate is auditionable; no multi-take library.
- Every usable candidate immediately starts idempotent draft persistence during review. Distinguish local candidate, saving, account-recoverable success, save failure/retry, accepting and accepted/stale. Cross-device recovery requires both durable media and account/project/turn association; uploaded bytes/local playback alone cannot prove it. Recover after sign-in without auto-acceptance or expiry until acceptance/explicit draft deletion/project/account deletion. Fence late candidate outcomes.
- Next with candidate freezes identity/revisions, persists/reconciles and durably accepts before progress/navigation. Failed save protects candidate/prior accepted take and stays. Candidate-free navigation creates no media/progress/billing/lock effects; end-with-gaps shows Remaining turns to record: N and First unrecorded turn without list. Accepted compatible partials count; replacement does not double-count.
- On any initial incomplete-to-complete durable acceptance, record/reconcile exactly one assembly authorization/trigger for the frozen accepted-compatible set, including a middle turn closing the last gap. Ordinary Next opens Result. Capture, draft save, navigation or local counts never trigger it. Back/leave/sign-out save that closes the final gap records/reconciles the same trigger before exit/release/session end, runs assembly in background and completes the requested destination. Uncertain trigger stays for reconciliation and never rolls back committed acceptance.
- Back candidate guard has exactly Save and go / Go without saving / Stay. Screen leave/sign-out uses Save and leave / Leave without saving / Stay. Save failures block exit, discard touches only unaccepted candidate, Stay changes nothing. Ordinary sign-out ends only current session after guard and recording-access release. Settings/session task consumes this guard rather than duplicating it.
- Completed-project replacement Next accepts/advances and stays Record; only explicit To result authorizes updated frozen-snapshot assembly. Candidate guard is exactly Save and go / Go without saving / Stay. Preserve previous finished result; Result never receives an unaccepted candidate or infers authorization from eligibility alone.
- Acquire/confirm one project-recording grant before capture/acceptance; held-elsewhere permits view but no capture/accept/force takeover. Explicit exit releases after guard; confirmed disconnect releases automatically, return reacquires and stale grant mutations are fenced. No invented heartbeat/expiry constants.
- Visible Process again exposes entitlement/cost and warned-draft replacement before first durable acceptance; afterward permanently unavailable with explanation. Launch preserves current preparation/draft; only successful authorized usable nonempty activation replaces/deletes it. Zero-turn reprocessing preserves prior usable turns/draft, unlike initial zero turns. Consume Processing domain behavior; do not implement a second lifecycle.
- Recording-domain mock handlers, source/mix descriptors and focused state/UI/cross-flow tests through shared facade/repository/scenario infrastructure. Simulated durability/exclusivity is explicitly labeled.

- Visual composition: Apply cataloged button, segmented-control and progress-tracker presentation plus explicit status/dialog derivatives to the confirmed media-first recording layout. Waveform, media playback/capture, turn target and safe-area controls are product derivatives; preserve target legibility, desktop normal-flow controls, phone pinned controls and exact guard choices.

## Out of scope

Manual transcript/speaker/timing/turn correction, Prepare/background-only approval, countdown/manual dialogue Stop, microphone gain, multi-take library, scoring/translation/cloning/time stretching, actual server media/storage/lease/render pipeline and private sharing. No selecting unknown timing/lease/copy/cleanup/product policy and no editing the unapproved scaffold.

## Implementation anchors and invariants

Flow 09 §9 defines logical load/navigate/grant/reference/capture/audition/draft/accept/assembly-handoff/reprocess/leave responsibilities, not existing endpoints or modules. HANDOFF states there is no approved runtime/test suite; find approved foundations at execution. Source/processing/turn/timing/candidate/accepted-set/grant identities fence async work. Automatic draft persistence, durable acceptance, permanent reprocess lock, initial assembly authorization and rendered result are distinct events.

Candidate preview uses one processed background, accepted replacement voices where present and original voices for unrecorded characters/overlaps; candidate substitutes only its target during review. Do not claim perfect isolation or actual mixing from descriptors/fixtures. Partial accepted remainder leaves target silence while background/others continue. Media compatibility must come from service evidence rather than client duration heuristics.

Approved tokens and exact shared typography/spacing/focus/motion apply. Desktop controls below waveform are in normal flow, never sticky/fixed; phone below 768px has bottom-pinned controls with safe-area/bottom scroll clearance, largest video and unobscured target. No random design draw may override approved media hierarchy or settle remaining geometry.

Readiness failure starts no false take; reference volume never changes captured/saved/final gain. F09-AC-02/03/05/22/35/36. Actual timing/mix proof remains blocked.
- [ ] AC-03: Full-window automatic completion and actual interruption produce correct review/failure states without autoplay/auto-acceptance. Prior candidate/accepted take survive failed recapture until their precise replacement boundaries. F09-AC-04/06/07/14/15/37.
- [ ] AC-04: Each usable candidate begins one idempotent draft save immediately; local/uploaded/account-recoverable/accepted facts stay distinct. Automatic draft save creates no accepted count/lock/assembly. Reload/cross-device simulated recovery offers only the exact durably associated draft without automatic acceptance or expiry; stale save outcomes cannot replace newer media. F09-AC-11/13.
- [ ] AC-05: Candidate-bearing Next accepts exact compatible identity durably before progress/navigation; timeout reconciliation and stale/duplicate/failed saves preserve prior accepted take and current retryable candidate. First durable acceptance permanently locks reprocessing; candidate-free navigation/tests/failures never lock it or charge. F09-AC-07/08/11/21/31/33/37.
- [ ] AC-06: First initial all-turn completion at any turn durably records/reconciles one frozen-snapshot assembly trigger. Next opens Result; Back/leave/sign-out closes guard and preserves requested destination with background assembly only after trigger safety. Failed/uncertain acceptance/trigger stays recoverable; committed acceptance is never undone. Completed-project Next never renders; To result explicitly authorizes accepted-only snapshot after its exact candidate guard. F09-AC-09/12/23/29/32 and TECH-10-10 boundary.
- [ ] AC-07: Guards expose the exact actions and semantics above. - [ ] AC-08: Reprocessing launch/lock/warning consumes Processing contract. Nonempty activation alone replaces draft/preparation; failure/cancel/rejection/zero-turn preserves prior usable Record continuation. Initial no-prior zero turns cannot enter Record/Result. F09-AC-19/21/31; BATCH-R01.

Deleted SPEC-002 and historical frontend evidence are not anchors.

React/Zustand views invoke centralized services; client memory is not session, provider proof or canonical-account authority. Unavailable session resolution keeps private content inaccessible without falsely declaring anonymity. Successful sign-in expires at the fixed point 30 days after success, survives browser reopen, never slides with activity and has no Remember-me option. Sign-in validates existing passwords for presence, without imposing registration composition rules. Passwords remain only in the active form lifecycle. ## Increment and context

A visitor completes one verified registration into New dub, or resolves an existing identity safely, with one canonical account/session and the authoritative welcome-grant result. Restored code-entry presentation never substitutes for verification.

## Scope

- Create-account form, Google registration purpose, same-screen six-cell email-code interaction, resend, email correction, pending restoration and completion/collision UI in EN/RU.
- Registration domain mock handlers and focused tests; share the accessible logical-code interaction with reset/linking without sharing proof purposes or mutable pending contexts.
- New canonical-account completion, first-time Google completion without emailed-code gate, same-email Google-only password addition, initial/verification-race existing-password collision and allowed post-deletion new-account/no-repeat-grant fixtures.
- Consume eligible-grant accounting and session/Google entry primitives from their owners; do not duplicate ledger, provider entry or generic persistence infrastructure.

- Visual composition: Own the reusable accessible otp-input visual adaptation with cataloged button and explicit input/password derivatives; retain one registration password field, same-screen verification, authoritative collision outcomes and product send/resend policy.

## Out of scope

- Real email/OAuth/identity/password storage, returning-identity retention policy and actual cross-device security enforcement.
- Password reset, manual different-email link creation/commit, direct password change, deletion and invented commercial/security policy.
- Transfer of pending registration between devices, extra repeat-password field, account merging or restoration of deleted product state.

## Implementation anchors and invariants

No approved registration implementation anchor exists. Inspect the accepted runtime/facade and actual checkout before implementation; the interrupted scaffold and deleted SPEC-002 are not adopted. Logical operations in Flow 03 section 7 specify responsibilities, not endpoints or file names.

One password field; minimum 8, no mandatory character classes. Email/password completion requires authoritative purpose-bound verification. Codes are exactly six decimal digits, valid 10 minutes after sending, resend no earlier than 60 seconds, at most five sends per service-defined hour and replacement invalidates the prior code. Client timers are presentation. Six visual cells represent one accessible logical value; changing to a complete value auto-verifies once, while unchanged rerenders and duplicate in-flight activation do not. Unknown is distinct from authoritatively invalid. A known incorrect code stays visible/selected with its error beneath the cells. No password/code in durable UI state or logs; correction requires a freshly re-entered password.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-01: One-password registration supports visible labels/show-hide/paste/managers, rejects the settled too-short case without adding composition rules and enters pending code state only from the service result. No account/session/grant is inferred from submission, navigation, restoration or abandoned pending state. Remaining counting/maximum rules stay blocked. (F03-AC01/06/14/16.)
- [ ] AC-02: Six-cell typing, whole-code paste/autofill and changed complete values each submit once; unchanged rerenders, duplicate/in-flight actions and known-incorrect unchanged values do not resubmit. Incorrect values remain selected/visible with the error underneath; uncertainty reconciles without invalid inference or blind retry. (F03-AC05/17.)
- [ ] AC-03: Authoritative send-time, expiry, resend eligibility/cap and replacement status drive the UI. Same-browser reload restores selected email/code-entry from an opaque reference with no resend/password restoration; another device starts a new request under unchanged limits. Change email requires a fresh password, invalidates the old code and completes only the corrected identity. Longer retention/hour-window mechanics remain blocked as listed. (F03-AC08/09/10.)
- [ ] AC-04: Valid email/password completion creates one verified account, a fixed 30-day session and eligible exactly-once 120-credit non-expiring grant, then opens New dub directly. First-time validated Google registration does the same without emailed-code gate; replay/retry/reload reconciles the same completion. Accounting is invoked through its shared primitive. (F03-AC04/07/20.)
- [ ] AC-05: Purpose-bound code verification for an existing same-email Google-only account adds the requested password and signs into that account without Google proof/settings detour, preserving library/balance/grant history. Existing-password collision at initial submit or verification-time race shows Account already exists with Sign in/Reset password, writes no password/account/session/grant and never overwrites. Manual different-email/conflict handoffs preserve their own proof requirements. (F03-AC02/03/18.)
- [ ] AC-06: Explicit re-registration after deletion may create a new canonical account/session and enter New dub, restores no prior account/project/balance and grants no repeat welcome allowance. Eligibility is a service fact, never a browser-readable deleted-identity marker. (F03-AC04/21.)
- [ ] AC-07: Bilingual responsive/keyboard/status/focus behavior, locale precedence, field-below/service-above error placement and token/motion geometry match the shared contract. Secrets remain confined to active form lifetime and clear on exit/success; no generated production credentials/codes are stored in test fixtures. (F03-AC12–16/19.)
- [ ] AC-08: Mocks explicitly cover cancellation/failure/unknown/conflict/replay/races and label email, code proof, password installation, Google, sessions, eligibility and grants as simulation. Open policy cases and real backend/provider checks are documented as blocked/unverified. (F03-AC11.)

- [ ] AC-VIS-01: Applicable Clean/Light component appearance and states follow the current adoption/token contract with Mabry Pro and shadcn semantics. Cover registration submitting/error, six-cell paste/autofill, invalid code retained/selected, unknown verification, resend countdown/unavailable and collision. Record the exact reference pair/state/value map and explicit derivative/contrast corrections; preserve every functional AC above. Missing required font/source/browser evidence blocks the affected visual claim.
